title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression gating CI hook + metrics integration
author: Anjali Rao
description: Motivation: We need deterministic CI-level checks that catch prompt-set regressions and surface eval metric deltas early in PRs. This change implements a per-prompt regression gating hook in the eval-harness CI pipeline and integrates selected eval metrics into the CI status output used by the Console dashboards. Goals: - Run lightweight per-prompt checks for core prompt sets on PRs touching model-serving, prompts, or eval harness code. - Fail the gate when predefined thresholds for key metrics regress beyond configured deltas. - Upload summarized metrics to the CI artifacts and emit structured annotations for the GitHub PR check UI. What I changed: single continuous description below; see file list for details. Checklist: [x] implement CI hook script, [x] register workflow, [x] add gating config and thresholds, [x] unit tests for gate logic, [x] docs for maintainers, [x] ensure metric payloads are small and privacy-safe. Related: ENG-1583 (per-prompt gating design), ENG-1620 (eval metrics dashboard integration).
commits: feat(eval-harness): add per_prompt_ci_gate script and entrypoint
ci(e2e): wire per-prompt gate into .github/workflows/eval.yml with conditional runs
test(eval-harness): add unit tests for gating thresholds and metric parsing
patch_snippets:
+++ b/eval-harness/ci/hooks/per_prompt_ci_gate.py
+def run_gate(metrics, thresholds):
+    regressions = []
+    for name, val in metrics.items():
+        if val < thresholds.get(name, -inf):
+            regressions.append(name)
+    return regressions

+++ b/.github/workflows/eval.yml
+    - name: Per-prompt regression gate
+      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
+      run: python eval-harness/ci/hooks/per_prompt_ci_gate.py --metrics ./artifacts/metrics.json

release_notes: Adds per-prompt regression gating CI hook and evaluation metric integration. Enables automatic PR checks for prompt regressions and uploads summarized eval metrics to CI artifacts.
notes_for_maintainers: Maintainers: thresholds live in eval-harness/config/prompt_gates.yaml. To add a prompt set, update the YAML and add a small calibration run to determine baseline metrics. The gate supports percent-delta and absolute-delta rules. If a noisy metric consistently blocks merges, use the opt-out flag or broaden the tolerance.
